text: 0119 left one scrambled alphabet alive only in the Beaufort form at key lengths 23 and 26. Consistency cannot decide those, so the alphabet is climbed toward English with the known letters held.
The same climb, same effort, on 12 scrambled coppers per length. K4 scores -5.81 at 23 (coppers -5.90 to -5.45) and -5.29 at 26 (-5.33 to -5.01): inside the range both times, low at 23.
Hidden English beat every copper in 3 of 6 trials at 23 and 1 of 6 at 26, and was never recovered. At 23 the test is weak; at 26, with one check, it cannot decide.
